cohort: The cohort consisted of 34 patients with a pathology-confirmed diagnosis of second-trimester placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who delivered within the second trimester.
finding: The study found no difference in maternal outcomes and morbidity between expectant management with cesarean hysterectomy and active management with cesarean hysterectomy for second-trimester PAS.
gest_age: Delivery within the second trimester; expectant management group delivered prior to 28 weeks' gestation.
